sourceNotice: 依据 textbook.md 的已核对原文生成；词族和迁移例句为配套拓展。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: One day, Sam found a storybook on his way home.
lines.chinese: 一天，Sam在回家的路上发现了一本故事书。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Whose book is this? I can give it to Mrs Fox tomorrow.
lines.chinese: 这是谁的书？我明天可以把它交给 Fox 太太。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam began to read the book. It was great fun.
lines.chinese: Sam开始读这本书。书非常有趣。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Then he tried to put it in his schoolbag.
lines.chinese: 然后，他试着把它放进书包。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Oh no, I broke it!
lines.chinese: 哦，不，我把它弄坏了！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Did you see my storybook yesterday? It's blue.
lines.chinese: 你昨天看见我的故事书了吗？它是蓝色的。

lines.speaker: Classmate
lines.english: No, I didn't.
lines.chinese: 没有，我没看见。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: No, I didn't.
lines.chinese: 没有，我没看见。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam did not feel good.
lines.chinese: Sam 感到不安。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He wanted to repair Bobby's book.
lines.chinese: 他想修补Bobby的书。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: After school, Sam repaired the book carefully.
lines.chinese: 放学后，Sam仔细地修补了这本书。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was not easy, but he tried his best.
lines.chinese: 这并不容易，但他尽了自己最大的努力。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam walked to Bobby's house. He wanted to say sorry to Bobby.
lines.chinese: Sam 走到了 Bobby 家。他想向 Bobby 道歉。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: My storybook!
lines.chinese: 我的故事书！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby looked at his storybook.
lines.chinese: Bobby 看了看他的故事书。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: I'm sorry. I broke your book.
lines.chinese: 对不起。我把你的书弄坏了。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: No, you didn't. I broke it last week!
lines.chinese: 不，不是你弄坏的。我上周就把它弄坏了！

sections.title: Sounds in focus — 字母组合 ea 的发音 /iː/

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: My teacher taught me
lines.chinese: 我的老师教导我，

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: To search for the truth,
lines.chinese: 要寻找真相，

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: And never to tell a lie.
lines.chinese: 永远不要说谎。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It is not always easy.
lines.chinese: 这并不总是容易，

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: But each of us should try.
lines.chinese: 但我们每个人都应该努力。

sections.title: Story time — Meng Xin and his ox

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Long ago, there was a poor man. His name was Meng Xin.
lines.chinese: 很久以前，有一个穷人。他的名字叫孟信。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He had a sick old ox.
lines.chinese: 他有一头生病的老牛。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: One day, Meng Xin was away from home.
lines.chinese: 一天，孟信不在家。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: His nephew sold the ox.
lines.chinese: 他的侄子把牛卖了。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Meng Xin came back home. He did not see the ox.
lines.chinese: 孟信回到家。他没有看见牛。

lines.speaker: Meng Xin
lines.english: Where's the ox? Did you sell it?
lines.chinese: 牛在哪里？你把它卖了吗？

lines.speaker: Nephew
lines.english: Yes, I did. We need the money to buy food!
lines.chinese: 是的，我卖了。我们需要这笔钱买食物！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Meng Xin did not want to sell a sick old ox to others.
lines.chinese: 孟信不想把一头生病的老牛卖给别人。

lines.speaker: Meng Xin
lines.english: Did you buy my ox?
lines.chinese: 你买了我的牛吗？

lines.speaker: Buyer
lines.english: Yes, I did.
lines.chinese: 是的，我买了。

lines.speaker: Meng Xin
lines.english: Sorry, I can't sell it to you. It's old and sick.
lines.chinese: 对不起，我不能把它卖给你。它又老又有病。

lines.speaker: Buyer
lines.english: It's very kind of you. Thank you.
lines.chinese: 你真善良。谢谢你。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Meng Xin got back his sick old ox.
lines.chinese: 孟信取回了他那头生病的老牛。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He got a good name too.
lines.chinese: 他还获得了好名声。
